newsitem.title: LATVIA: INDUSTRIAL PRODUCTION FALLS 0.6 PCT IN FEB.
newsitem.headline: INDUSTRIAL PRODUCTION FALLS 0.6 PCT IN FEB.

text.p: Latvian industrial production fell 0.6 percent in February on a year-on-year basis, the statistics committee said on Friday.

The committee said in a statement that production in the quarrying and extraction industry fell by 16.5 percent, the energy and gas sector by 16 percent although the manufacturing sector saw a rise in output of 6.8 percent.
It said that the largest rise in output was in the pulp and paper sector, which rose 151.9 percent and the electrical machinery and apparatus production sector, up 95 percent.
